ArticleSettings.title: ArticleSettings
ArticleSettings.description:
Combined article-assistant + paper-discovery settings.

This aggregate is the public type used by services and routes.  It keeps the
flat field layout of the legacy model so ``model_dump`` / ``model_validate``
and the HTTP request/response bodies are byte-compatible.

AsyncPaperSearchRequest.title: AsyncPaperSearchRequest
AsyncPaperSearchRequest.description: Task15 async catalog search: only server-controlled scope is accepted.

ConferenceUpdateRequest.title: ConferenceUpdateRequest
ConferenceUpdateRequest.description: 受控会议配置更新；Task03 仅允许启停，不允许改写源身份。

ImportRequest.title: ImportRequest
ImportRequest.description: Empty action body; source URLs are always resolved from the node.

KBAskRequest.title: KBAskRequest
KBAskRequest.description:
知识库问答请求（spec-011 / spec-012）。

模型由用户从顶部 modelSelect 自选；`chunker` 为 spec-012 新增的切分版本
选择，默认 `v1`，仅允许 `v1` / `v2`。

PaperImportBatchRequest.title: PaperImportBatchRequest
PaperImportBatchRequest.description: Create a batch from an opaque server-side search snapshot only.

PaperImportBatchResponse.title: PaperImportBatchResponse
PaperImportBatchResponse.description: Public batch status payload shared by create/get/retry routes.

PaperImportItemActionRequest.title: PaperImportItemActionRequest
PaperImportItemActionRequest.description: Empty item action body; URLs and credentials are never client input.

PaperImportRequest.title: PaperImportRequest
PaperImportRequest.description:
Single-paper import request.

URLs, titles, conference names, and other candidate metadata are not
accepted from the client.  The route resolves both identifiers against
the server-side search snapshot before invoking the importer.

PaperImportResponse.title: PaperImportResponse
PaperImportResponse.description: Stable result fields returned by the single-paper import endpoint.

ResearchAcquisitionPreviewRequest.title: ResearchAcquisitionPreviewRequest
ResearchAcquisitionPreviewRequest.description: Read-only classification of the current server-side candidate snapshot.

ResearchAcquisitionRequest.title: ResearchAcquisitionRequest
ResearchAcquisitionRequest.description: User confirmation envelope; candidate URLs/snapshots are never accepted.

ResearchEvidenceMatrixRequest.title: ResearchEvidenceMatrixRequest
ResearchEvidenceMatrixRequest.description: Bounded Claim/Evidence matrix proposal; facts remain server-validated.

ResearchEvidenceUpgradeRequest.title: ResearchEvidenceUpgradeRequest
ResearchEvidenceUpgradeRequest.description: Full-text claim upgrade; document ids are checked against Research links.

ResearchPaperDisplayRequest.title: ResearchPaperDisplayRequest
ResearchPaperDisplayRequest.description: Batch lookup of human-readable paper labels (read-only projection).

ResearchReportRequest.title: ResearchReportRequest
ResearchReportRequest.description: Bounded request for deterministic generation from the stored matrix.

ResearchSessionCommandRequest.title: ResearchSessionCommandRequest
ResearchSessionCommandRequest.description: All button and natural-language approvals use this exact command shape.

ResearchSessionCreateRequest.title: ResearchSessionCreateRequest
ResearchSessionCreateRequest.description: Task02 base schema for the conversational research session boundary.

ResearchTaskCreateRequest.title: ResearchTaskCreateRequest
ResearchTaskCreateRequest.description:
创建研究任务请求。

`goal` / `conversation_id` 声明为可空是为了由本模块统一转成 400
``PLAN_VALIDATION_FAILED``：若交给 pydantic 必填校验，缺失字段会变成 FastAPI
默认的 422 ``detail``，破坏 027 稳定错误体契约。

ResearchTaskPatchProjectRequest.title: ResearchTaskPatchProjectRequest
ResearchTaskPatchProjectRequest.description: 移动/解绑项目归属；``project_id`` 为 null 表示解绑（可显式传 null）。

ResearchTaskRecoverRequest.title: ResearchTaskRecoverRequest
ResearchTaskRecoverRequest.description: Optional checkpoint envelope for a safe interrupted-task inspection.

ResearchTaskResumeRequest.title: ResearchTaskResumeRequest
ResearchTaskResumeRequest.description: Optional durable SchedulerCheckpoint envelope for a paused task.
